payload.detail: TWO SMALL THINGS LEFT BEHIND BY PR #2860, both found while fixing something adjacent, both deliberately not fixed there. (1) UPDATE NOTICE OVERLAP (2026-09-17 audit, its L4; the dismissal half of L4 IS fixed in #2860). globals.css moves .pwa-notice-stack out of the bottom-right corner only under body:has(form.answer-footer-search-edge), so on Documents and other modes the notice stays over page content and controls. The audit reports it intercepting clicks. UNVERIFIED AND NOT FIXED: the first attempt keyed on a class name that was assumed rather than checked and does not exist (.master-search-dock), and without a browser the overlap cannot be seen or a fix confirmed. Guessing at clinical-interface CSS is not worth it. NEXT: reproduce at desktop width on /?mode=documents with the notice showing, then widen the selector to whatever really owns a fixed bottom composer - or reserve the corner. Note the rule already moves the stack to the TOP on answer views, so check that does not simply trade one overlap for another over the header. (2) SERVICES MODE HAS NO MODE-NOUN LIST. modeSearchWords in src/lib/smart-search-intent.ts:246-250 has entries for calculators, factsheets and dictionary only. Since #2860 let short plain queries contribute their own subject words, 'service' now survives as a term in services mode and matches most of the catalogue. Harmless but unhelpful; filling that list is a relevance decision about the services mode, which is why it was left. NEXT: decide the services (and any other smart-search mode's) stop list alongside whoever owns services relevance. PART 1 REPRODUCED AND RE-DIAGNOSED 2026-09-18, DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED. Measured in a real browser at 1024x800 on ?mode=tools: the install sheet made FIVE interactive controls unreachable - 'Ask PsychSift Search', 'View example' and three calculator tabs - with document.elementFromPoint returning the notice card for each. So the audit's L4 is real. BUT ITS STATED MECHANISM IS REFUTED, and this row's own earlier text repeated it: the fix is NOT to widen body:has(form.answer-footer-search-edge) to whatever owns a fixed bottom composer, because Documents, Tools and Differentials have NO fixed bottom composer at desktop width at all. Measured overlap between the notice and any fixed bottom composer is 0 on every mode tested (documents, answer, tools, differentials at 1440 and 1024). There was never a composer collision on those pages; the collision is with the page itself. ALSO MEASURED: .pwa-notice-stack already sets pointer-events:none, so the container is click-through - it is the cards inside it that land on content. AND THE OBVIOUS FIX WAS TRIED AND REJECTED ON EVIDENCE: anchoring the stack to the top on every wide view took the blocked count from five to two, i.e. it traded one set of covered controls for another, exactly as this row warned. WHAT IS LEFT is a design decision, not a CSS guess: whether a floating notice may cover page content at all, or whether the corner must be reserved, or the card made smaller. A browser guard was added pinning the one invariant that must hold either way (the container stays pointer-events:none). PART 2 (services mode has no mode-noun stop list) is unchanged and remains a search-relevance decision for whoever owns services relevance; src/lib/smart-search-intent.ts was deliberately not touched.
